content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Has been a Judge of the High Court; Or has, for a combined period of ten years, been a District Judge or an Additional District Judge; Or has been an advocate for ten years with substantial experience in litigation in matters relating to indirect taxes in the Appellate Tribunal, Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal, State Value Added Tax Tribunal, High Court or Supreme Court. Experience required: Ten years as District Judge/Additional District Judge (combined) or ten years as advocate, as applicable. Age limit: Maximum age limit of 67 years (tenure); minimum age of fifty years shall not apply for eligibility. Pay: Basic Salary: ₹ 2,25,000 (fixed). Qualification required: Is or has been a member of the Indian Revenue (Customs and Indirect Taxes) Service, Group A, or of the All-India Service with at least three years of experience in the administration of an existing law or goods and services tax in the Central Government, and has completed at least twenty-five years of service in Group A. Experience required: At least twenty-five years of service in Group A. Age limit: Maximum age limit of 67 years (tenure); minimum age of fifty years shall not apply for eligibility. Pay: Basic Salary: ₹ 2,25,000 (fixed).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure of five years, subject to maximum age limit of 67 years Pension, Provident Fund and gratuity not admissible for service in the Tribunal Place of posting subject to change/transfer under CGST Act and GSTAT Rules Must join within 30 days from the date of issue of appointment order (declaration)

content_sections.heading: How Will GSTAT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications by the Search-Cum-Selection Committee based on qualifications and relevant experience Personal interaction of shortlisted candidates, if deemed necessary and proper Recommendation by the Committee on overall evaluation; appointment by the Government Applications scrutinized for suitability having regard to qualifications and relevant experience Shortlisted candidates may be called for personal interaction by the Committee, if deemed necessary and proper Committee recommends suitable candidates on the basis of overall evaluation

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Certificate of Employer in Annexure-II (serving officers) Copies of 10 Judgments decided by the applicant (High Court Judge / District Judge / Additional District Judge) Bar Council Registration Certificate and last 5 years ITR (advocates) Copies of 10 Judgments argued by the applicant (advocates) Copies of 10 adjudicating orders, if any (Technical Member (Centre)) Photograph of candidate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSTAT Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online at https://gstn.org.in/gstat-online-application/ in the form prescribed in Annexure I with necessary documents. Portal active from 15.11.2026; last date for applications is 30.12.2026. Applications through any other mode are liable to rejection. If a document cannot be uploaded, email it by the last date to [email protected] , mentioning the online application number. Serving officers must attach the employer/head of department certificate in Annexure-II. Portal issues: contact [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA admissible for interview/interaction Applications after due date or without necessary documents liable to rejection Cut-off date for eligibility is the last date of submission of the application Violating declaration conditions may lead to debarment for three years

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 December 2026. Applications opened on 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 20 vacancies: 15 Judicial Member, 5 Technical Member (Centre).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 30 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is maximum age limit of 67 years (tenure); minimum age of fifty years shall not apply for eligibility (as on last date of submission of the application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Basic Salary: ₹ 2,25,000 (fixed) for Judicial Member, Basic Salary: ₹ 2,25,000 (fixed) for Technical Member (Centre).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Judicial Member: Judge of a High Court, or District Judge/Additional District Judge for a combined ten years, or advocate for ten years with substantial indirect tax litigation experience. Technical Member (Centre): member of IRS (Customs and Indirect Taxes) Group A, or All-India Service with at least three years in administration of an existing law or GST in the Central Government, with at least twenty-five years of Group A service. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be declared medically fit by an authority specified by the Central Government. Serving Officers or sitting Judges shall either resign or obtain voluntary retirement before joining the Tribunal. Indicate three preferences for the place of posting in the application.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications by the Search-Cum-Selection Committee based on qualifications and relevant experience. Personal interaction of shortlisted candidates, if deemed necessary and proper. Recommendation by the Committee on overall evaluation; appointment by the Government. Applications scrutinized for suitability having regard to qualifications and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure of five years, subject to maximum age limit of 67 years. Pension, Provident Fund and gratuity not admissible for service in the Tribunal. Place of posting subject to change/transfer under CGST Act and GSTAT Rules.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Judicial Member: Srinagar, Shimla, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Cuttack, Ranchi, Raipur, Kolkata, Vishakhapatnam, Bangalore, Madurai, Coimbatore, Thiruvananthapuram, Guwahati, Chennai, Technical Member (Centre): Bhopal, Patna, Vishakhapatnam / Vijayawada, Bengaluru, Kolkata, A Member may be posted at any of the benches of the Tribunal.
